change: Stage helper/plist and validate plist before stopping an existing registered daemon; preserve previous files for activation-failure recovery.

installationTests.launchctl: Owned stub executable only; no system launchctl invocation
installationTests.filesystem: Actual install/cp/mv/plutil commands using current uid/gid in private fixture directories
cases: Missing staged binary and invalid plist leave running old fixture and files untouched
Failed bootout leaves old files and registration untouched
New bootstrap failure restores old files and attempts old registration while retaining original failure exit code
Failed first install removes newly activated files without creating an old service
Failed recovery retains original backup files and reports directory
Symlinked target refused before service stop
Registered service without both backups refused before service stop
Successful first install and upgrade clean staging and set 755/644 modes
Entire multi-line privileged AppleScript compiles using osacompile without execution

limitations: No real privileged install, system service restart or hardware control was performed
File-level recovery does not prove runtime policy/control recovery or complete App rollback
Existing helper --source auto-update may follow the current App again; this transaction does not roll back the App or freeze that updater
Concurrent privileged installers, power loss and SIGKILL interruption are not covered
Requires new signed package and installed acceptance
